comparison.objective: Route a condensate hose continuously downhill into a drain, not tune shock absorption.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable hose shaping over supports and nozzle insertion; no adjuster manipulation, locking torque, or impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Hose slopes downhill without a water-trapping dip and its nozzle enters the tundish; numeric slope/dip tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests global deformable-route geometry and drainage.
